coaching.headline: Legion killed four of us 16 times while two of five bought armor; we held Orb Prime and still lost.
coaching.team: We lost this to one hero and never adjusted. Legion killed four of us 16 times, all seven of Muriel's deaths and four of Murdock's nine among them, and only two of five bought armor. The early game was a trade: Gideon and Murdock died at their Fangtooth at 9.5 and we took Mini Prime at 11. The middle was the duo dying in our own jungle. Muriel and Murdock lost 0-2 to Legion and Steel at our Fangtooth at 24.6 and again at our inner tower at 28.1, and a tower fell within a minute of each. At 30.9 Legion alone killed three of us with five of ours alive to their three, and Primal Fangtooth went to them. There was still a way back: the fight at our inhibitor at 33.8, won 3-1, was followed by Orb Prime and the Genesis Core. Then Murdock was caught alone by Shinbi at 36.7, the last fight was 4v5 at their core, and our core fell at 38.1. Next game: everyone their carry has killed buys armor on the next back.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: The duo fights in our own jungle. Muriel and Murdock took Legion and Steel two-on-two at our Fangtooth at 24.6 and at our inner tower at 28.1, lost both 0-2, and a tower fell within a minute of each. Then 30.9: five of us alive, and Legion killed three.
coaching.whatWorked: Vision and conversion. We placed 50 wards to their 34, and every fight we won was cashed: the fight at 23.2, won 3-1, became our outer tower and Fangtooth within a minute.

Two solo deaths, to Legion at 13.8 and Steel at 25.6, on 36,553 damage to heroes.

perPlayer.ed187ebf-450b-4f23-be5e-cb691e6328fe: Murdock donated the last fight. The carry lane was the one Legion won: 16 kills to 6.
perPlayer.ae57df87-d868-498b-af8b-4562f987f67a: Muriel warded the map and was the body Legion farmed. Twenty-six wards, the most of anyone in the game, a hand in 12 of our 21 kills, and 11,031 healing. Legion killed her seven times, once alone at 7.1 and the rest inside fights; she bought armor, so the fix is spacing and a third body, not her shop.

10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.text: Two solo deaths and no kill or death in the seven fights that lost the duo lane; the wave is unknowable, the count stands.

a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.text: Led our objective damage at 32,378 and set up Orb Prime, then died to Legion at 30.9 in a fight we had five to three.

fed26803-69a9-4fa1-b140-21f3cdf8d8e3.text: Highest damage to heroes on our side and the most mitigated in the game; the offlane was fine and the map lost it.

ed187ebf-450b-4f23-be5e-cb691e6328fe.text: Nine deaths, four to Legion, and the solo catch at 36.7 that turned the last fight into a 4v5.

ae57df87-d868-498b-af8b-4562f987f67a.text: Twenty-six wards and a hand in 12 of 21 team kills; Legion killed her seven times, a peel and spacing problem the duo owns.

30.9.call: Do not chase Legion three-man with Primal Fangtooth up. Five of us alive to their three, and he killed Khaimera, Muriel and Murdock by himself; Primal Fangtooth went to them at 31.6. Group five instead.

37.5.call: Never fight at their core 4v5. Murdock was dead 45 seconds earlier to a solo catch, Legion killed three of us, and our core fell at 38.1. With the carry down, back off and fight when five are up.

33.8.call: The right call: Gideon and Khaimera won it 3-1 at the inhibitor with Murdock dead, and Orb Prime followed at 35. From here the game is won by grouping five and pushing one lane; nobody walks alone.

10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.build: Azure Core, Combustion and Wraith Leggings were all there; four completed items in 38 minutes is the note, not the choice.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.eternal: Vesh with The Tenth Seal and Mind Rot fits a Black Hole mage whose damage is all abilities, adding a damage-over-time tick to every Cosmic Rift and a stronger ultimate after level 10.

a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.build: Void Helm was the right magic-resist call against four magical damage dealers, but Legion was the one physical threat and killed him three times. Rapture, the skipped core item, adds attack speed with omnivamp and health; against a 16-kill Legion the better swap was Sky Splitter to an armor item.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.eternal: Vermis with Serration and Melting Point pays out on the third straight basic on one target, which is Khaimera's stick-and-stun pattern, at the cost of the extra health Krix would give a jungler Legion killed three times.

fed26803-69a9-4fa1-b140-21f3cdf8d8e3.build: Six items off the core produced our highest damage to heroes, and Fire Blossom's armor kept him off Legion's kill list; nothing to teach here.
fed26803-69a9-4fa1-b140-21f3cdf8d8e3.eternal: Vesh with The Tenth Seal and Mind Rot suits a root-and-grind control mage whose Web Lash and Consume are ability damage, over the flat health Krix would give a frontliner.

ed187ebf-450b-4f23-be5e-cb691e6328fe.build: On core with Vanquisher and Imperator, plus the only anti-heal item on our side in Tainted Rounds; the build was fine, and the nine deaths were the problem.
ed187ebf-450b-4f23-be5e-cb691e6328fe.eternal: Vermis with Serration and Melting Point rewards a marksman who keeps his basics on one target, which is Murdock's whole kit, over the wider item-stat boost of Demiurge.

ae57df87-d868-498b-af8b-4562f987f67a.build: Muriel built for herself and skipped the whole core. Golem's Gift and Gaussian Greaves gave her armor that Legion killed through seven times; Crystal Tear and Windcaller would have made her shields bigger and given the carry the speed to leave the fights at 24.6 and 28.1 alive.
ae57df87-d868-498b-af8b-4562f987f67a.eternal: The engine does not model support Eternals; the field runs Exarch on Muriel, which turns each of her shields into attack speed for the ally.

threats: Heal-stacking: Steel. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 1 item of it.
Enemy is 4/5 magical — one magic-resist item goes a long way.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Akeron Web Lash (root 1s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Muriel) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Alacrity shield+AS → Consecrated Ground bubble → Reversal global save
ourKits.winCondition: keep the carry alive with global shields and enable their damage
ourKits.passive: abilities grant Sentinel to allies; on-hit bonus
ourKits.playAgainst: she has no damage threat — dive her carry through the shields or pick her first

ourKits.combo: Void Breach slow → Cosmic Rift → Black Hole on the grouped enemies
ourKits.winCondition: land Black Hole / Cosmic Rift on a clumped team for AoE burst
ourKits.passive: an ability-empowered basic tethers a target for bonus damage
ourKits.playWith: hard engage that clumps enemies into his Black Hole
ourKits.playAgainst: immobile with long cooldowns — dodge the skillshots and dive him once Black Hole is down

ourKits.combo: Web Lash root → Crushing Maw armor shred → Hellfire eye → Consume pull-channel
ourKits.winCondition: root with Web Lash and grind with Hunger-stacked haste
ourKits.playWith: follow-up burst on his rooted target
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge Web Lash — without the root he has no lock-down; interrupt Consume

ourKits.combo: Ambush leap → Unleash AS → Cull stun, Invigorate to cleanse+heal
ourKits.winCondition: stick on one target, stun with Cull and out-sustain via Spirit Regen
ourKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his Cull stun
ourKits.playAgainst: ANTI-HEAL is mandatory — it guts his whole kit; kite the leap and CC through Invigorate

ourKits.combo: Static Trap root → Buckshot → Hot Pursuit AS → Long Arm of the Law global snipe
ourKits.winCondition: trap for the root, then out-range with Shots Fired and finish with the global ult
ourKits.passive: every 5th basic is a long-range bonus shot
ourKits.playWith: frontline/peel to protect his low mobility
ourKits.playAgainst: almost no escape — engage past the trap and he dies

enemyKits.combo: Boreal Sweep slow → Hoarfrost root → Glacial Charge engage → Cryoseism stun ult
enemyKits.winCondition: chain frost CC (slow→root→stun) to lock the fight down
enemyKits.playWith: burst that converts her long CC chain into kills
enemyKits.playAgainst: she's a CC battery — cleanse/QSS the Cryoseism stun; spread to avoid the chain

enemyKits.combo: Bull Rush knockback → Force Shield wall → Shield Slam knockup+stun ult, Shield Bash %hp
enemyKits.winCondition: peel the carry with walls/knockups or engage with Shield Slam
enemyKits.playWith: a carry he can wall for and peel
enemyKits.playAgainst: his Force Shield blocks projectiles — reposition around it; bait Shield Slam

enemyKits.combo: Rushing Beat dashes → Line Tempo wolves → Circle Rhythm shield → All-Kill! wolfpack ult
enemyKits.winCondition: stack Track and unleash All-Kill! in a grouped fight
enemyKits.playAgainst: spread vs the wolfpack; she's squishy without her shield up
